historical_record.description: KPOO, the community radio station, bought this building in 1985 and broadcasts from it. Identified in 2024 as eligible for local landmark, California Register or National Register designation.
A permit was sought for a three-storey frame building of sixteen apartments with a basement, estimated at $20,000. J. C. Hladik was named as architect.

The Redevelopment Agency agreed to sell the four-story wood-frame building at 1325-29 Divisadero Street, with sixteen studio apartments over a shop floor, to KPOO and Associates, a joint venture with the radio station KPOO, for rehabilitation.
